description: This file defines a data access layer with repository classes for interacting with the database in a sports live stream backend application. It includes classes for users, profiles, matches, events, emojis, and highlights, implementing common CRUD operations with SQLAlchemy ORM, async support, and some fallback mechanisms.

classes.name: BaseRepository
classes.description: A common base class providing the database session for other repositories.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: Repository for CRUD operations related to user entities, including creation, retrieval, and update.

classes.name: UserProfileRepository
classes.description: Repository for handling user profile data, including creation, retrieval, and updates.

classes.name: MatchRepository
classes.description: Repository for fetching match data with various filters and complex selection logic.

classes.name: EventRepository
classes.description: Repository for events, including retrieval with filtering options and fetching specific events.

classes.name: EmojiRepository
classes.description: Repository for emoji assets and reactions, including adding reactions and summarizing emoji reactions for events.

classes.name: HighlightRepository
classes.description: Repository for highlights, including fetching highlights by match, ID, and getting featured highlights.

methods.name: UserDB create_user(self, user_data: UserCreate, password_hash: str)
methods.description: Creates a new user record in the database with normalized role and logs the input data.

methods.name: Optional[UserDB] get_user_by_id(self, user_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches a user by their user ID.

methods.name: Optional[UserDB] get_user_by_email(self, email: str)
methods.description: Fetches a user by their email address.

methods.name: Optional[UserDB] get_user_by_username(self, username: str)
methods.description: Fetches a user by their username.

methods.name: Optional[UserDB] update_user(self, user_id: str, user_data: UserUpdate)
methods.description: Updates user details based on provided UserUpdate data.

methods.name: UserProfileDB create_profile(self, profile_data: UserProfileCreate)
methods.description: Creates a new user profile with a generated UUID and current timestamps.

methods.name: Optional[UserProfileDB] get_profile_by_user_id(self, user_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a user profile based on user ID.

methods.name: Optional[UserProfileDB] get_profile_by_id(self, profile_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a user profile by its profile ID.

methods.name: Optional[UserProfileDB] update_profile(self, profile_id: str, profile_data: UserProfileUpdate)
methods.description: Updates profile data with provided UserProfileUpdate fields and current timestamp.

methods.name: List[MatchDB] get_matches(self, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0, status: Optional[MatchStatus] = None, sport: Optional[SportType] = None)
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of matches with optional filtering by status and sport type.

methods.name: Optional[MatchDB] get_match_by_id(self, match_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches a match with its related entities by match ID.

methods.name: List[MatchDB] get_live_matches(self)
methods.description: Retrieves all matches with status 'LIVE'.

methods.name: List[MatchDB] get_upcoming_matches(self, days: int = 7, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0)
methods.description: Fetches upcoming matches within a specified number of days.

methods.name: List[MatchDB] get_more_matches(self, limit: int = 12, offset: int = 0, exclude_ids: List[str] = None)
methods.description: Fetches a varied list of matches, prioritizing live, recent, upcoming, and remaining matches with deduplication and pagination.

methods.name: List[EventDB] get_events(self, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0, sport: Optional[SportType] = None, featured: Optional[bool] = None)
methods.description: Retrieves events with optional filters for sport type and featured status.

methods.name: Optional[EventDB] get_event_by_id(self, event_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches an event with its associated matches by event ID.

methods.name: get_emojis(self, limit: int = 10, offset: int = 0)
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of active emojis, with fallback SQL querying for minimal schemas.

methods.name: Optional[EmojiAssetDB] get_emoji_by_id(self, emoji_id: str)
methods.description: Gets a specific emoji asset by emoji ID.

methods.name: str add_reaction(self, user_id: str, event_id: str, emoji_id: str, created_at: Optional[datetime] = None)
methods.description: Adds a reaction emoji to an event/match, generates a new reaction ID.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_reaction_summary(self, event_id: str)
methods.description: Compiles emoji reaction counts, top emojis, and overall reaction stats for an event.

methods.name: List[HighlightDB] get_highlights(self, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0, match_id: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Retrieves highlights, optionally filtered by match, with ordering and pagination.

methods.name: Optional[HighlightDB] get_highlight_by_id(self, highlight_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches a highlight by its ID with related match info.

methods.name: List[HighlightDB] get_featured_highlights(self, limit: int = 10)
methods.description: Fetches most recent or popular highlights, limited by count.
